conditions.text: C1 — 1.1.54: an operation taught for what FOLLOWS (a 5th-case condition, via 1.1.67) applies to its FIRST sound. Apavāda of 1.1.52.

quotes.quote: क्व च परस्य कार्यं शिष्यते? यत्र पञ्चमीनिर्देशः।

conditions.text: C2 — 1.1.55 overrides it by paratva: a multi-sound or śit substitute replaces the whole even after a 5th-case word (अतो भिस ऐस्, अष्टाभ्य औश्, ङसोऽश्). A लुक् removes the whole suffix (1.1.61), and a samāsānta lopa takes the final, so 1.1.54 has no say there.

quotes.quote: अतो भिस ऐस्। अनेकाल्शित्सर्वस्येत्येतद् भवति विप्रतिषेधेन।
अष्टाभ्य औश् <{SK372}> इत्यादौ आदेः परस्य इत्येतदपि परत्वादनेन बाध्यते

conditions.text: C3 — Method: commentators very often name 1.1.54 in a counterfactual ("if the sūtra were worded otherwise, 1.1.54 would give the wrong form"), i.e. to explain why the sūtra is worded as it is. That is a reason the rule does NOT operate, not an application.
